text:
alyssa: sharing the new mock for the latency page — idea is a cohort-compare toggle that overlays two p95 lines + a sampling sweep control. want quick feedback on affordance and copy :eyes: jamal: quick peek — love the overlay idea. question: how does the sampling sweep interact with the time-range scrubber? feels like two knobs for similar behavior. alyssa: good call. proposal: scrubber stays for time window selection, sweep is a scoped sampling rate for the selected cohort comparison only (so you can lower noise for the diff). i can add a tooltip explaining that. helen: UX nits: the toggle label currently "Compare cohorts" is vague. suggest "Compare cohorts (live vs canary)" OR make it a dropdown that lists cohorts. also need a small explanatory microcopy under the toggle for first-time users. mike: accessibility: color palette for overlayed lines needs non-color cues. for colorblind folks use different strokes — e.g., solid vs dashed. also ensure the toggle is keyboard focusable and has an aria-expanded when the dropdown is open. alyssa: noted — solid = prod, dashed = canary. will update. for microcopy thinking: "Compare cohorts: overlay p95 for two selected cohorts. Toggle sampling to reduce noise." feedback? jamal: copy tweak: shorter is better. maybe: "Overlay p95 for two cohorts. Use sampling to smooth noise." also: put the sampling % next to the slider as exact number (not just the visual). helen: agree on exact number. also add a small "Why sample?" inline link that opens a tooltip with the tradeoffs (latency vs fidelity). screen-reader note: tooltips must be dismissible with ESC. design-bot: accessibility checklist: toggle has label association, slider has aria-valuemin/max/now, dashed stroke has 3px width for visibility at 1x zoom. mike: tiny UI ask: when overlay is active, the heatmap should dim to 40% so the lines are readable. but preserve keyboard focus styles for heatmap interactions. alyssa: I can prototype dimming. also thinking about a mini-legend pinned below the scrubber with toggles to hide/show each cohort line — helps when they overlap. jamal: analytics question: if someone uses sampling sweep, can we log the final sampling % and cohort pair so Optimize can suggest a default? would help with auto-suggestions. mike: yes, but be careful with PII in cohort names. strip ids. store only anonymized cohort keys. alyssa: implementation note for eng: sketch pasted below — HTML for the toggle area:```html
10%
``` small CSS note: add `stroke-dasharray: 6 4;` for the dashed line so it prints clearly. helen: microcopy pass: change compare button text to "Overlay cohort" and sampling tooltip text to:"Reduce sample to smooth noisy signals; higher samples increase fidelity." jamal: one more UX thought — add an explicit "reset" affordance that snaps sampling back to baseline and hides the overlay. helps users recover after experimenting. alyssa: will add a small "reset" link next to the sampling-value. final checklist for me to update mocks: 1) label copy changes, 2) dashed stroke + legend toggles, 3) dim heatmap when overlay active, 4) sampling % numeric display + reset, 5) tooltip content + esc dismissible, 6) analytics event name: `cohort_compare_used` with anonymized keys. mike: looks great. can we also include a keyboard-only flow doc for eng? like steps to open dropdown, select cohort, toggle compare, adjust slider, toggle legibility — helps a11y testing. alyssa: yep — i'll attach a short keyboard flow in the next revision. thanks everyone :heart:
